title: Shaucha
one_line: Purification, of two kinds: external washing of the body and internal purification of the mind through universal friendliness.
points: There are two types of shaucha: bahir shaucha (external purification) and antah shaucha (internal purification).
Bahir shaucha involves washing the outer body with red clay and water; rubbing the body with clay removes sweat and dirt and makes the body soft and shiny.
Antah shaucha means viewing everything and every being as a friend (maitri), treating all with affection, and considering everything a reflection of God.

Guruji writes that from this twofold shaucha, a loathing develops for the body, seen as abominable, essenceless, and perishable, and a disgust is felt when touching the body of another, leading one to hesitate to indulge in sin.

sutra.translation: Owing to purity, there is a desire to protect one's own body, being the non-contact with whatever is adverse (to that).
